description: did:vh resolution vectors: options. Call didvh-resolve with input; compare didResolutionMetadata.error and problemDetails.vhLog.code, or the document, metadata and sorted warning codes.

cases.name: no-log
cases.description: Neither didLog nor srcLog.

cases.name: log-and-src-log
cases.description: Both didLog and srcLog.

cases.name: witness-and-src-witness
cases.description: Both didWitness and srcWitness.

cases.name: log-not-string
cases.description: didLog must be a string.

cases.name: witness-not-array
cases.description: didWitness must be an array.

cases.name: two-selectors
cases.description: More than one version selector.

cases.name: version-number-zero
cases.description: versionNumber must be positive.

cases.name: version-number-string
cases.description: versionNumber must be a number.

cases.name: version-number-fraction
cases.description: versionNumber must be an integer.

cases.name: version-time-fraction
cases.description: versionTime must have whole seconds.

cases.name: version-id-number
cases.description: versionId must be a string.

cases.name: min-copies-zero
cases.description: minCopies must be positive.

cases.name: check-watchers-boolean
cases.description: checkWatchers must be a non-negative integer or "all".

cases.name: check-watchers-negative
cases.description: checkWatchers must not be negative.

cases.name: check-watchers-other-string
cases.description: The only string checkWatchers value is "all".

cases.name: extra-watchers-http
cases.description: extraWatchers must be https URLs.

cases.name: extra-watchers-string
cases.description: extraWatchers must be an array.

cases.name: include-did-log-string
cases.description: includeDidLog must be a boolean.

cases.name: src-log-invalid
cases.description: srcLog: http is only for loopback hosts.

cases.name: src-log-fragment
cases.description: srcLog must not have a fragment.

cases.name: src-witness-invalid
cases.description: srcWitness: https needs a domain name.

cases.name: src-log-file-remote
cases.description: A resolver serving other systems refuses local file references.

cases.name: src-log-loopback-remote
cases.description: A resolver serving other systems refuses loopback references.

cases.name: src-witness-file-remote
cases.description: The check applies to srcWitness too, even when it is not needed.

cases.name: src-log-web
cases.description: This resolver does not retrieve from web locations.

cases.name: src-log-file-local
cases.description: This resolver does not read local files.

cases.name: src-log-other-scheme
cases.description: This resolver does not support other schemes.

cases.name: check-watchers
cases.description: This resolver does not contact watchers.

cases.name: check-watchers-all
cases.description: This resolver does not contact watchers.

cases.name: extra-watchers
cases.description: This resolver does not contact watchers.

cases.name: watchers-zero
cases.description: checkWatchers 0 and an empty extraWatchers need no watchers.

cases.name: src-witness-unneeded
cases.description: srcWitness is not an error when the log needs no witnesses.

cases.name: src-witness-needed
cases.description: This resolver does not retrieve a srcWitness the log needs.

cases.name: src-witness-invalid-entry
cases.description: A witness list set only in an invalid entry is never active, so srcWitness is ignored.

cases.name: include-did-log-invalid-witness-entry
cases.description: No didWitness is returned when only an invalid entry sets a witness list.

cases.name: src-witness-later-entry
cases.description: A valid later entry that turns witnessing on makes the log need witnessing.

cases.name: include-did-log
cases.description: includeDidLog returns the valid entries, not shortened to the selected version.

cases.name: include-did-log-false
cases.description: includeDidLog false returns nothing extra.

cases.name: include-did-log-witness
cases.description: includeDidLog also returns the witness proofs file when witnesses are required.

cases.name: include-did-log-on-error
cases.description: Nothing is returned when resolution fails.
